description: This file is a BitBake recipe (.inc) for building the Vala programming language, a C#-like environment dedicated to GObject programming. It contains metadata, dependencies, configuration, and build instructions related to Vala, including dependency management, configuration steps, file installation, and packaging.

methods.name: vapigen_sysroot_preprocess
methods.description: Adjusts the vapigen pkgconfig file to point to the wrapper script in the target sysroot, ensuring that the wrapper is used during building vapi files.

methods.name: vala_package_preprocess
methods.description: Modifies the vapigen wrapper script to remove the sysroot prefix, making it suitable for the build environment.
